name: Boku wa Tousan o Aishiteru ~Koakuma ga Shikakeru Amai Wana~
original_name: ボクは父さんを愛してる ～小悪魔が仕掛ける甘い罠～
source: The protagonist has married an older woman and moved in together but joining them was her college aged son. Turns out protagonist admits that his stepson is closer to his ideal woman in looks than his own wife. Also happens his stepson is very friendly and looking forward to get closer to him.
